analysis:
The PR changes only docs/developer/build.md: a 'Last updated' date bump and a rewrite of the CI workflow table and hourly-run section near base lines 360-395. The supplied units are unchanged base text for lines 481-1165 (CI runner routing, job sizes, CI caching, dev build identity, App Attest release qualification, verify, troubleshooting), so no changed lines appear in them. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the rewritten section was only partly visible.

I looked for new attack surface and invalidated threat assumptions and found none in the visible text. No code, workflow, key handling, attestation logic or prefix-cache behavior is changed, so T-041, TB-011 and related threats are not affected. The documented CI cache and routing controls (cache disabled on unprovisioned Darkbloom runners, `.git` hook scrubbing, restore only on exact digest match, saves only on master/dev pushes) are descriptive and appear unchanged.

Remaining question for integration: the truncated patch for lines 360-396 could not be fully seen, and the actual workflow YAML files are not in this batch. If workflows changed alongside the docs, a separate pass should check the doc claims against them. This documentation-only unit does not by itself indicate a security regression.
